criteria.description: Active membership comes from fresh exact-identity presence, and visible current P1 status matches runtime state.
Publishers inspect only their own workspace and no viewer path dispatches, moves, closes, or adopts foreign agents.
Active and History are visibly grouped with short space-first labels that fit supported viewports.
Historical URLs, persisted snapshots, control-state/custom flows, SSE, and pane placement remain exact and readable.
Heartbeats avoid ledger churn, incompatible servers are skipped without termination, and focused/full checks remain reliable.
